'''Elom''' was a cold and barren [[Desert/Legends|desert]]-like [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was home to the [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] and [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Elom lived in the caves of the [[A'driannamieq Mountains]] while the Elomin lived on the surface.

==Description==
Elom was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] civilization claimed large portions of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface for mining and limited agriculture, but vast tracts of wilderness remained. These areas included desert plains and small mountains, which were inhabited by nomadic packs of [[ranphyx]].<ref name="COTG" />

==History==
Some time before the [[Great Galactic War]] The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nul]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] built a [[Temple of Nul|temple]] on this world, housing many of her creations. It was later abandoned, and all records of Nul were stripped from Imperial records by the time of the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Ruins of Nul" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[cave]] paintings were discovered on Elom which suggested that contact between the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] occurred earlier than it was recorded.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|History from the Dark}}</ref>

[[File:Elom_Elomin_FiB.png|thumb|left|200px|An [[Elom/Legends|Elom]] and an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]].]]
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] first made contact with the Elomin in [[120 BBY]] but with the [[Elom/Legends|Eloms]] only in [[50 BBY/Legends|50 BBY]]. Some scientists hypothesized that the Elomin were descended from a lost [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] colony. Upon the world's discovery, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] hailed it as a significant find, due to its large deposits of [[Lommite/Legends|Lommite]]. Lommite was mined on Elom for use in [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], and was the cause of the first interaction between the Elom and the Elomin. The planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by [[Rennimdius B'thog Indriummsegh]].

===Conquest by the Empire===
Such a valuable world could not be left to its own devices, at least in the view of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the planet was [[Invasion of Elom|conquered]] by Imperial forces, the Elomin were forced to slave away in the lommite mines. Since the Empire had not discovered the cave-dwelling Elom, they were able to help some Elomin escape [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. This further bonded the two species together. The more technically-advanced Elomin worked to sabotage Imperial mining efforts. Many Elomin joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], with the liberation of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] their driving force.

===Under the New Republic===
After the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] liberated the planet, the two species formed an alliance. Elom was a founding member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], represented on the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] by [[Verrinnefra B'thog Indriummsegh]]. The planet was later represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by [[Rattagagech]]. During the [[Thrawn campaign]] Elom was near the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]], a stretch of space that separated New Republic space from Imperial held portions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This proximity to Imperial controlled territory made the Elomin worried of repeat aggression. They instituted a massive armament program as a preventive measure. Elomin that served in the New Republic military during its early years tended to serve in units composed of just themselves, though this began to subside as the Elomin became more comfortable around other species.

===Yuuzhan Vong Invasion===
Elom was one of many worlds in the Outer Rim to fall victim to attack by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The world's complex series of caves and passages no doubt proved difficult to the invaders. As a result, the invasion was repelled.
